needs.premise: One logical call after operand evaluation, stable complete CallInputView premise, actual four-arg no-handles heap budget14; finite arena offsets/stack budget12 are geometry examples, not actual caller FrameSpec; one reservation request, two ticket serials, old client reply, input/layout generations, one GC, initialized-prefix consumption and body-entry terminal; source/ABI/physical allocator and arbitrary callback/liveness proof remain open

30 conditional interval-fit/disjointness, caller-word arithmetic, stamp equality exclusions, initialized-prefix cursor and ticket/root lifecycle Step/Trace declarations; caller full-view and physical mapping are premises; no complete QNT/C allocator/generator/ABI simulation

Create rooted CallInputView after operand evaluation; stage an already resolved target only at its allowed resolution point, or use target-independent arity envelope for late-bound global calls, without hoisting observable global reads; establish the view and before destructive expansion/argument relocation, R0 overwrite or native SFUN_ARG stores; dynamic apply cut before POP_ARGS2 and PUSH loop in app after wrapper splice, direct GVM cut before earliest destructive move and with all collecting block checks before final grant, native typed staging before raw outgoing stores and ___call; existing helper entry or late ___call is not a complete caller-view issuer

Preflight failure or cancellation retains exact logical target, ordered evaluated arguments/input spine, original continuation and native marker/code/result backing in collector-updateable roots; immutable/version-stable apply input can count then expand, general mutable input requires qualified single-read scan-safe staging, not rereading expressions/list after GC; no GC from existing unframed raw outgoing area; unknown source/input-root closure rejects managed profile

Physical grant names one actual msection incarnation/semispace/layout and contiguous cursor window plus stack interval; exclude chunk link and end markers, require word alignment/checked offset arithmetic, heapHi<=stackLo when sharing, and no conflicting allocator/writer capability; logical global free space, fudge and compile-time reserved counters are not this proof; grant leaves hp unchanged so this profile needs no new sparse/uninitialized-gap scan contract; account initialized prefix plus unused reserved words once, and close/refund only unused capacity, never committed objects

Canonical noncollecting tryReserve on complete rooted input view is final allocator-layout effect before a no-GC/no-reentry shuffle/repair interval; reserve includes all rest pairs from first CONS plus fallback packet, frame/argument stack and metadata budgets; unused grant cancellation and construction entry share one arbitration; no intervening allocating helper/POLL or legacy heap_limit cursor migration while lease live; initialize objects then advance actual prefix hp, close lease at complete FrameReady before GC

Unused grants must be canonically canceled before GC or allocator layout reassignment, active partial writer must finish full FrameReady and close lease first; flip/reset/reuse invalidates old epoch/layout/serial even at same address; after round/context/binding and root reload, rederive bounds from same stable logical call input and issue new ticket without reevaluating expressions; already completed rest packet needs fresh execution authority, not another rest construction grant

Known deny keeps complete root view and unchanged allocation cursor; lost grant ACK retains canonical unused grant and query rights, not a second reservation; unknown native allocator/assignment result retains arena transaction debt and cannot become deny/refund by timeout; failed/unknown cancel or entry outcome retains canonical responsibility; caller-input stability, ABI and origin profiles must be qualified, and original arity/error/tail/native return semantics are not replaced by invented pending success

Release-publish complete rooted call view before reservation; same atomic registry serializes grant/cancel/enter and GC/layout close; allocation owner and disjoint actual intervals validated before canonical grant, acquire consumer validates server status/epoch/layout/serial/input plus current cursor; last constructor store/initialized prefix and full frame precede lease close and GC admission; collector relocation precedes acquire root reload and new grant; old replies cannot mutate claimed writer permit, stale refund cannot retire new grant; actual C pointer arithmetic/atomics/lock order and helper effects remain open

Source chain GET_REST -> handler7 -> finish remaining CONS -> fully initialize packed vector -> two-argument Scheme helper -> save R0/proc/args and install return frame -> FRAME_STORE_RA/W_ALL -> actual GC; first W_ALL calls noncollecting heap_limit before repair and is ineligible for park; generated RestConstructionPlan binds exact progress, complete-frame PointId/FrameSpec and scan map, not arbitrary partial C stack locals

Reserve a construction lease before destructive argument pops; no collecting/reentrant call while partial argument stack/vector lacks complete scan layout; keep partial rest, remaining/required arguments, proc/temp1 and original continuation under exclusive source custody; transfer proc/packed-vector to generated register/frame roots before local scope ends; collector-updateable cells and fresh post-GC handle reload, plus marker/native ancestor roots; all-domain RC/raw alias integration remains open

Close new native root borrowers and writers under same registry cut; pre-close writer remains counted through its actual final effect, then materialize matching root generation; relevant borrowed moving values must drain or use admitted stable handles, native-only argv/code/result backing can remain leased; a queued/issued store cannot be revoked by entry closure; late write after receipt invalidates protocol and requires exclusion proof, unknown result retains source duty and blocks receipt

FrameReady after full vector initialization, full mapped Scheme call frame, RA/GVM spill, exact root generation and native-frame/capacity lease precedes release-published offer; source pins until canonical VM accept, lost ACK does not restore old authority; one park attempt owns scan/resume/exit arbitration; offer is not scanner permission; no side-effecting rollback or duplicate constructor from unknown acceptance

After scan/root readers drain, whole-round/capacity result, context preparation, same live owner binding and relocated-root reload, claim exactly one normal or exit authority in next epoch; normal branch reloads the same packed vector and proc, restores np arguments, sets nargs=-1 and jumps target, so GET_REST cannot rebuild the rest list; same original native invocation/catcher continues, no replay or helper-thread longjmp

Preflight physically reserves repair words, stack/frame and root/control metadata before pops; close new native writer/borrow admission, settle actual old final effects, complete vector and FrameSpec/GVM writes, release-publish offer, canonical accept/acquire scan; scanner writes release before whole-round/context/binding/acquire reload; exclusive fresh normal/exit claim prevents late scan and duplicate nargs resume; all raw aliases share the cut; no locks held across owner/GC wait; actual C atomic layout, helper visibility and native ABI refinement remain open

Known deny / unresolved result\nkeep full roots; no argument replay

callers.actualChain: apply wrapper may splice own rest list before app; app immediately POP_ARGS2 then PUSH each car while walking cdr, finally jump target
callers.hazard: Collecting reserve inserted inside raw PUSH loop would expose partial incoming argument frame; retrying wrapper can repeat mutation
callers.replacement: New CallInputView cut at Scheme app boundary before inline C pops/expansion, after original evaluation/splice; logical inputs preserved

callers.actualChain: Current app counts na while pushing, detects >MAX_NB_ARGS, removes pushed args then tail raises limit exception
callers.hazard: No existing count-before-expand descriptor or stable snapshot; two-pass count can change mutable input observations
callers.replacement: Stable input profile or scan-safe single-read CallArgPacket staging; retain target and spine/prefix roots; preserve invalid-input/error read order

callers.actualChain: Jump carries opnd/ret/nargs/poll/frame; emitter may overwrite R0 or spare destination, emit block checks, adjust stack then jump
callers.hazard: Late-bound global target lookup also cannot be hoisted across collecting callbacks; reserve at final jump may already follow destructive operand moves
callers.replacement: Scheme semantic completion emits pre-shuffle CallInputView and final grant/consume region; source producer placement proof remains open

callers.actualChain: Compile-time reserved counters drive checks; jump inline/direct dispatch may bypass generic rest entry
callers.hazard: Compiler reserved count and passing POLL do not reserve an exclusive physical interval; late poll can invalidate grant
callers.replacement: Run required collecting checks with complete view first, then final noncollecting grant; specialize exact body/argument contract instead of blanket rest charge

callers.actualChain: c-make-function converts parameters, generated make-body emits SFUN_ARG stores then SFUN_CALL; BEGIN allocates marker earlier
callers.hazard: Converted SCMOBJ locals and raw outgoing stores are not automatically a complete GC view before ___call
callers.replacement: Typed NativeCallInputView/root frame before raw stores; preserve conversion order, error/result ABI and same invocation leases

callers.actualChain: ___call assumes C caller already placed args above fp, builds return marker frame, pops regs and sets target
callers.hazard: Collecting capacity request inside ___call before reconstructing rooted outgoing inputs is not automatically safe
callers.replacement: Preflight at staged native caller; keep return-to-C frame construction noncollecting under exact stack lease

callers.actualChain: Marker allocator uses make_vector before copying proc, source TODO for protecting input; SFUN conversion errors may call Scheme
callers.hazard: Native staging cannot claim safe preflight if marker/proc roots already unprotected
callers.replacement: Root target before marker allocation, all-domain handles and complete ancestor native root/exit plan; inherited gap stays open

callers.actualChain: set_heap_msection selects tospace half; prepare leaves two end marker words, writes first link word and starts data chunk
callers.hazard: Raw half-section size overcounts client data; allocating a logical window must not skip uninitialized prefix
callers.replacement: Grant current hp-to-dataHi offsets after metadata; fresh separate half has 65533 candidate data words by source arithmetic only

callers.actualChain: Shared msection changes both limits with fudge and 1/4-versus-3/4 split
callers.hazard: Independent heap/stack scalar capacity can double-promise intersecting bytes
callers.replacement: Grant actual disjoint intervals and guard budget under one layout incarnation, or use separately owned sections

callers.actualChain: Current scanner/allocation tracks chunk start, markers and initialized allocation prefix
callers.hazard: Publishing an uninitialized gap as a scannable copying chunk is unqualified; collector-copy chunk limits and mutator data bounds are different roles
callers.replacement: Cursor-window lease leaves hp unchanged; write complete objects and advance only initialized prefix; chunk transitions must join plan or be excluded

callers.actualChain: heap_limit can take free msection or get next section, prepare new hp/limits, or signal GC need
callers.hazard: A ticket for prior hp/layout does not remain valid across this helper even without GC
callers.replacement: Replace admitted repair path with lease-local noncollecting budget/need-GC check, close lease at full frame before normal collector

callers.actualChain: stack_limit may allocate/reuse msection and migrate frames/stack break; old section can join free list
callers.hazard: Same GC epoch does not imply unchanged stack interval/cursor or live pointer locations
callers.replacement: Layout generation changes invalidate unused grants; qualify stack-demand FrameSpec and prohibit migration inside leased shuffle

callers.actualChain: setup_stack_heap_vmstate flips tospace offset, resets per-PSTATE free list/section/cursors/chunk queues
callers.hazard: Old capacity receipt cannot survive semispace flip/reset; addresses can later repeat
callers.replacement: Cancel unused grants and settle active constructors before GC, use epoch+layout+serial and reissue against new actual intervals

callers.actualChain: GC phases/resize/fudge then prepare context, with notification before preparation; TLS binding is separate
callers.hazard: GC interrupt/result alone does not authorize new raw cursor use or stale root access
callers.replacement: Whole-round result, exact owner/context binding and relocated CallInputView handle reload before new grant or completed packet resume

callers.actualChain: f3 generic rest source and real Tcl setter -> variadic tcl caller provide zero/one-required four-arg shapes
callers.hazard: Direct specialization/generic slow execution and physical pressure are conditional; no native run receipt
callers.replacement: Front-load all four/three pair costs plus fallback packet; retain existing single native invocation and nargs=-1 completed-packet resume

callers.actualChain: alloc_mem_lock protects selected section operations; PSTATE cleanup frees resources before later join result handling
callers.hazard: Allocation lock is not a complete per-call ticket/GC exclusion protocol; unknown stop cannot retire active writer
callers.replacement: VM canonical reservation records, no GC-critical lock held while waiting, known stop/final-effect evidence before range reclamation
